name: Charmane Jackson
source:
"Takes part in cheerleading events nationwide, and at times even worldwide. She's studying sports psychology amongst other sport-related subjects.
She has a very high opinion of herself. Her parents are divorced. Her dad, originally from Costa Rica, needs to take long business travels all around the world. She has a bitchy attitude and mostly just uses men for sexual pleasure.
Charmane lives next door to Summer Baker and they're best friends. Together, they've enjoyed in ruining relationships of several men."
